instruction: Use VLC media player to play the purchased movie 'Inception' from your iTunes Store library.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because iTunes Store movies are protected by Apple's FairPlay DRM technology. VLC cannot decrypt or play FairPlay-protected content. iTunes purchases can only be played through Apple's official applications (iTunes, Apple TV app) that have the necessary DRM licensing and decryption capabilities built in.
